## Report: PayPal payment support for Studio Nexis

**Isolation & access.** SSH to `51.79.226.215` used the platform's ssh2 approach — decrypted `server.rootPasswordEnc` (server id `cmsecmdps0001hlp27ai6mr7c`) via AES-256-GCM/`AUTH_SECRET` exactly like `lib/sftp.ts`, fed straight into ssh2 (never echoed), and asserted hostname/IP `51.79.226.215` (hostname `nexis-app`) before every command. Prod/staging trees never touched.

**Payment-method abstraction.** New `src/lib/paypal.ts` mirrors `lib/stripe.ts`: `studioPayPalConfig/Enabled/Public(tenant)` read per-tenant creds from `policies.paypal` (`clientId`, `secret`, `mode` sandbox|live, `enabled`, `webhookId`) — the exact pattern of `studioStripe`. So a studio can run Stripe and/or PayPal independently. Settings → Money gains a PayPal card mirroring the Stripe UX (connect / replace / pause-turn-on / disconnect), handled by a new `section === "paypal"` branch in `src/app/api/settings/route.ts` that verifies creds via a live OAuth token before saving.

**Order/capture/verify flow.** Orders v2 with per-tenant creds:
- `POST /api/public/paypal/create-order` — server computes the amount (package price from DB; gift-card amount validated against the studio's min/max), creates the PayPal order, and writes a server-side `PayPalOrder` intent row. The client never dictates the amount.
- `POST /api/public/paypal/capture` — calls PayPal capture itself, requires `status === COMPLETED` and that captured amount+currency match the intent, *then* grants. It records a paypal `Order`+`ClientPackage` or mints a `GiftCard`+txn+email — the same records Stripe produces — so POS / my-packages / redemption work identically. Idempotent via new unique `paypalOrderId` columns (retry/double-capture/webhook can only find the existing record).
- `POST /api/public/paypal/webhook` — a signature-verified reconciler safety net (verifies against the studio's `webhookId`, re-runs the same idempotent grant).

**Where the button shows.** PayPal buttons (official JS SDK, public client-id only) render on the packages booking page (per package, when PayPal enabled + customer signed in) and the gift-cards booking page (a new client checkout component that also keeps the Stripe form when Stripe is on).

**Self-gate.** PayPal stays completely dark unless creds are verified AND the studio explicitly turns it on (`studioPayPalEnabled` requires `enabled && clientId && secret`). No button reaches the server routes otherwise, and the routes 400 when disabled. No credentials are ever invented.

**Studio must supply:** (1) a PayPal REST app at developer.paypal.com → Client ID + Secret; (2) choose Sandbox/Live, paste into Settings → Money → PayPal, Save, then Turn on; (3) optionally register the webhook URL `https://<studio-domain>/api/public/paypal/webhook` and paste the Webhook ID to enable the reconciler.
